en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Al Khaybari, from Yunus Bin Zabyan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High not Created Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> for (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, there would not have been a match for her<sup>asws</sup> on the surface of the earth, from Adam<sup>as</sup> and the ones after him<sup>as</sup>’ (until the Day of Judgement).
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from al-Khaybari from Yunus ibn Zabyan who has said the following. “I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘
Had Allah not created Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) for Fatima, there would been no match on earth for her from Adam to the end.”
